case_information.customer_feedback_summary: Guests repeatedly praised the hotel's central, quiet location, cleanliness, and friendly, helpful staff (including attentive family-run service and accommodating luggage storage). Criticisms include a simple or repetitive breakfast, generally small rooms with limited storage and occasional missing amenities (no minibar/safe), some outdated or awkward bathroom layouts, a small TV, and an isolated report of an employee making an inappropriate joke.
